summary: Voice and sound night for Craze & Crash: measured our 8 Shorts' pace (185-217 words a minute) and mix (music 17.6-18.2 dB under the voice, on target), and added one core founder-bet Short topic: Marvel pledging ten heroes' film rights for a $525M loan, then Disney's $4B.
why: The core founder_bet lane had one open topic; Rise Fall Repeat's Marvel Short is the niche's biggest on-niche breakout (2.28M on 19.9K) and every figure is in Marvel's SEC filings or Disney's release. No challenger: the mix is on target, and the only pace evidence is vendor opinion against the owner's 1.5x choice.
